This resin is found chiefly in semi-arid climates, especially in coniferous forests, and is best known in southern Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains fairly easy to find.

Yellow Hemlock yields a resin called Harfy, which is applied directly to wounds. It stops most bleeding almost immediately and retains its properties for a year in an airtight container. Such convenient storage makes it useful for travelling healers, although repeated use can cause habituation.
